title: InstaNFT
tagline: Multichain NFT social network based around curation and likes.
description: Multichain NFT gallery as well as a social network around curation and selection of NFTs. NFTs are rapidly becoming a part of the web3 identity, and a look into someones NFT portfolio tells a lot about the person. Currenlty there are cumbersome ways to present and curate all this information, we plan to make a convenient platform to present this information.
how_its_made: We have used react, nextJS, hardhat for building the webapp. For APIs we have used Moralis (Ethereum, Polygon NFT scraping), Rarible (NFT indexer APIs for Ethereum blockchain), NFTport (Tezos blockchain NFT APIs) as well as etherscan and quiknode.We have used react, nextJS, hardhat for building the webapp. For APIs we have used Moralis (Ethereum, Polygon NFT scraping), Rarible (NFT indexer APIs for Ethereum blockchain), NFTport (Tezos blockchain NFT APIs) as well as etherscan and quiknode.
